name: Commissary
overview: The biblical concept of commissary involves appointed officers responsible for providing food and provisions to both royal households and armies, as seen in Solomon's administration. In 1 Kings 4:7-12, Solomon had twelve officers over Israel who managed the supply of victuals for the king and his household, each serving monthly. These officers were assigned specific regions, ensuring organized and faithful stewardship of resources to support the king's household and related needs.
